items:
Experience unparalleled comfort and breathtaking views at Beachside Dunes, a completely renovated 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom beachfront condo. Enjoy panoramic Gulf vistas and unforgettable sunsets from every room in this beautifully appointed space. Each of the three king suites is equipped with a new smart TV, with one suite featuring an additional set of built-in XL twin bunks for extra sleeping space.

Located just steps from the water, our condo is the closest building to the beach—access the sand through your private beach gate in under a minute! Explore the charming town of Seaside, just two blocks away, or stroll to dozens of restaurants within walking distance. This exclusive condo community is the only beachfront property in WaterColor, offering a unique, intimate experience for those seeking luxury and convenience.

As the property owners, we pride ourselves on providing personalized service. You’ll always have direct access to us, ensuring prompt responses to any questions or concerns. For guests who value cleanliness, rest assured that the condo is impeccably maintained: all floors are steam cleaned after each stay, and all linens, including top quilts, are freshly laundered.

Enjoy access to a private condo pool (exclusive to only 22 units) and a private beach entrance right outside your door. Inside, the condo boasts a fully remodeled gourmet kitchen and bathrooms, along with a reverse osmosis system for purified drinking water and ice.

Convenient dedicated parking for two vehicles is provided, and you'll also have full access to the fantastic amenities in the WaterColor development, including the newly opened Beach Club pool and restaurant, Camp WaterColor, Tennis Center, Western Lake, the Boathouse, and miles of scenic biking and walking trails.

Come unwind in luxury at Beachside Dunes—where every detail is designed for the discerning guest.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
